subject.title: fix(mattermost): preserve websocket posts across restarts

question: Should the Mattermost ingress repair be extracted into a narrow PR, with the unrelated gateway, database, MCP App, iMessage, Microsoft Teams, UI, iOS, and documentation work reviewed separately?
rationale: The branch’s mixed scope includes global startup and security-sensitive gateway behavior, so preserving or splitting the aggregate work is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical correction.

options.title: Extract the Mattermost repair
options.body: Keep only the Mattermost durable-ingress implementation and its focused tests, then submit the other feature groups as separately scoped work.

options.title: Sponsor the aggregate review
options.body: Explicitly assign owners and require separate proof and security review for every unrelated feature group before merging this branch.

recommendation.title: Extract the Mattermost repair
recommendation.body: Keep only the Mattermost durable-ingress implementation and its focused tests, then submit the other feature groups as separately scoped work.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history ties this contributor to the durable-ingress implementation and related channel migrations.
